verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents a locations directory where users "Choose from 2500+ locations" and "Find a location near you," and it explicitly supports multiple mailboxes in different locations. It also claims the addresses meet business registration requirements in most states, which supports picking an address to fit an entity strategy. missing for 10: explicit evidence of state/city browsing or filtering, confirmed availability in Delaware and Wyoming specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration of the location listing.
